title: Paris outdoor, nature and walking — strict visit-week deep research

method.inclusion: A specific outdoor objective with a non-generic story and an ordinary legal public walk: reclaimed landscape, unusual ecology, living landmark tree, supervised seasonal swim or cemetery landscape.
method.source_gate: At least two useful sources for every retained row, including a current official municipality, land manager or operator source; OpenStreetMap or official open data fixes the exact coordinate but never establishes access alone.
method.current_status_gate: Access, seasonal hours, works and closure controls were checked on 2026-08-09 for a 2026-08-13 to 2026-08-16 visit. Same-day manager checks remain mandatory for heat, fire, storms, water quality and river current.
method.confidence_gate: Every retained confidence value is high.
method.dedupe_gate: IDs, normalized names, aliases, external IDs and all 17,237 catalogue coordinates were checked globally at 120 metres; retained candidate pairs were also checked internally.
method.hard_exclusions: No generic park, ordinary viewpoint, private garden, ticket-only attraction, dead or unverified tree, hazardous or closed route, broad duplicate, filler, or objective outside the raw Paris bbox.

visit_week_controls.parks_and_woods: Paris and regional managers may close green spaces without notice during severe weather, exceptional heat or fire danger. Recheck the named manager page on the day; carry water because an on-site fountain can also be out of service.
visit_week_controls.seine_swims: Only the three supervised sites are legal. Opening is decided from daily bacteriological results, current, weather and operational conditions; check the live municipal status before travelling.
visit_week_controls.canal_swims: La Villette is scheduled daily, while Canal Saint-Martin is scheduled only Sunday 14:00–18:00 in the visit window; last-minute cancellation remains possible.
visit_week_controls.grenelle_event_reset: Grenelle's 1–9 August event closure ends before the visit window and the published schedule resumes 10 August, but live water-quality status still controls.
visit_week_controls.trees_and_cemeteries: The objects are outdoors, but their host garden, park or cemetery hours control access; severe-weather closures can supersede the listed summer timetable.

model_audit_note.known_overlap_false_positive: The repository cityForPoint helper can infer the overlapping regional slug maisonsalfort for valid eastern-Paris coordinates because its regional bbox covers much of Paris and its centre is closer. Rows intentionally preserve the research contract's city='paris'; raw-bbox, catalogue and distance audits are still authoritative for this dossier.

included.a: 45 bis avenue de la Belle-Gabrielle, Paris
included.s: Walk a public experimental garden whose paths still frame the uneasy remains of France’s tropical-agronomy and colonial-exhibition history.
included.q: Jardin d'Agronomie Tropicale René-Dumont Paris
included.w: Follow the wooded public paths through a site created for tropical crop research and used for the 1907 colonial exhibition. The surviving gate, pavilions and memorials are historic objects to view from the open paths, not abandoned buildings to enter.

facts.claim: The municipal garden is scheduled daily from 09:30 to 20:00 during August; exceptional weather can supersede those hours.
The site was created in 1899 as an experimental garden for tropical agronomy and contains structures associated with the 1907 colonial exhibition.
The public experience is a path walk through the grounds; surviving historic structures are not an invitation to enter fenced or closed fabric.
